usage: The word '季候' (gwai3 hau6) refers to a season or a time period characterized by particular weather conditions.
'季候' is a noun and can be used as a subject or object in sentences when talking about seasons.
You can combine '季候' with specific names of seasons, like '春季候' (spring season) or '冬季候' (winter season).
It is often used in weather contexts to describe changes or qualities of time periods during the year.
When talking about nature or activities related to different times of the year, '季候' is commonly used.
